releaseNotes: Portable Chrome Android study enhancements are now enabled in the Computer PWA: Share, Copy, Read aloud, answer strike-through, doctor expression controls and progress-card sharing.
Exam Goal Planner now supports multiple exams, daily question targets, review and rest days, Smart Review, specialty breakdowns and study-progress trends.

Question speech defaults to English (US), offers English (UK) and Arabic, prefers local voices for offline use, preserves Slow/Normal/Fast speed and falls back to Arabic when the selected English voice is unavailable.
Android-only haptics and native notification scheduling remain disabled on Computer. Computer install, fullscreen, screen wake-lock and silent update behavior remain in place.
The offline package manifest advances by file hash while retaining the existing cache, so only changed offline files need updating. Existing answers and study progress are preserved.
